_readme: Rosters, placements and dates: English Wikipedia "Final standings" tables (data/cache/wikipedia-standings.json), except rosters marked "source": "unverified", which were written from knowledge and need checking with `npm run fetch-data`.
Roles, ratings (60-99), coach ratings and player nationalities are game data written for Major Mayhem, not official statistics.
Dailies must not change once played: give a new roster "since": "<tomorrow>"; never delete a roster, give it "until": "<today>"; changing an existing roster changes every daily it appears in.
Player ids default to the nick lowercased with non-alphanumerics removed (the same person keeps one id across rosters). Two different people whose nicks collide need an explicit "id".
